items.title: File Klage against the order at the Verwaltungsgericht
items.quote: Innerhalb eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe kann gegen diesen Bescheid Klage beim Verwaltungsgericht Musterarnsberg, Jägerstraße 1, 59821 Musterarnsberg, erhoben werden.
items.computation: The Bescheid is dated 18.11.2026 but the cover letter notifying it is dated Thu 19.11.2026; posting day is taken as 19.11.2026 (the earliest it could have been posted). Under § 41 Abs. 2 VwVfG a letter from a German authority sent by ordinary post counts as delivered on the 4th day after posting, i.e. Mon 23.11.2026 (no weekend/holiday shift applies to this deeming rule itself). Under § 187 Abs. 1 BGB the one-month period for the Klage starts the day after delivery, i.e. from 23.11.2026, and under § 188 Abs. 2 BGB ends one month later on the day with the same number, Wed 23.12.2026. That day is a Wednesday and not a public holiday in NRW, so no further shift is needed. Final deadline: 2026-12-23.

warnings: The letter sets ongoing operating-hour restrictions for the woodsplitter (weekdays 9–12 and 15–18 only, none on Sundays/public holidays) with no calendar deadline attached, so no dated item was created for this compliance duty — the person should still follow it going forward.

A bank IBAN is printed in the footer (DE96 4625 0049 0003 0007 00, valid format) but the letter demands no payment, so there is nothing to pay against it; treat any later payment request tied to this Aktenzeichen with normal caution and verify the payee name match before transferring.
